task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (all 43 criteria ids/weights; full text of cw_save_reload_restart:339-345, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_stale_save_keeps_draft, cw_history_restore_adds_revision, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, cw_live_library_update, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft)
evidence: Defining behaviour (custom editor + run/preview/console + saved snippets with history) is graded by dozens of functional criteria, e.g. cw_custom_typing_and_line_join, cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic, cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_basic_run_output, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_history_restore_adds_revision. Durability: the constraints gate cw_shared_saved_record saves a typed snippet, clears all origin storage per app_context.md:28 and reloads, so a localStorage-only app fails the gate. The scored cw_save_reload_restart (functional/judge.toml:339-345) builds revisions 1 and 2 (distinct second marker) and a restored revision 3 via a recorded HTTP request, notes all three revisions' exact sources, clears storage and reloads, then calls the single-use restart_app tool, which (test.sh:127-193, byte-identical to the template) kills the node process group and relaunches it on the same DB_PATH, waiting for HTTP; the prompt forbids inferring a restart from a reload/health (prompt.md:31-33). After restart a fresh page must show the same single record, current revision, fields and revision list, and each of the three revisions must show its noted source, with revision 2 the only one carrying the second marker; then the recorded restore is replayed and must add no revision. Broken apps tried: (a) in-memory store or localStorage cache -> fails storage-clear or restart; (b) app that persists only current snippet row and rebuilds history from it or loses old snapshot bodies on restart -> revision 2's unique marker is missing, fails (this closes the previous round's hole where only revision 1, equal to current revision 3, was re-read); (c) idempotency kept only in memory with no base-revision check -> replay after restart adds revision 4, fails, consistent with behaviour.md's unconditioned 'if the same restore request arrives again ... it shouldn't create another revision'. Conforming alternatives: a server-durable app using base-revision checks or a persisted operation id passes (golden server.js persists restore_operations and snapshots in SQLite; replay also hits the stale-revision 409). Server-backed is proven by storage clearing plus real process restart, not by same-origin assumptions. Compared to the pre-24c4a77e text, the change only adds the requirement to note and re-verify revisions 2 and 3; nothing became looser for the model. Residual risks (why risk=true): (1) no measured full configured judge run or scripted golden run on this v16 candidate is cited (raw-evidence-index.json absent), so the golden passing the tightened restart flow and its added browser workload within the 9000s budget are unmeasured; (2) minor wording ambiguity: the parenthetical 'whether or not the history list also shows the current one' tolerates a history list without the current revision, but the new step says 'open each of the three revisions in history', so a strict judge could fail a conforming app whose history panel lists only past revisions (golden lists all, app.tsx:159-160).
suggested_fix: Optional: say 'open each of the three revisions in history (or the current snippet, if the history list omits the current revision)'; and record a scripted golden run of the restart flow on this candidate.
